items.title: Project overview
items.summary: Footnote is a transparency- and provenance-focused AI framework with backend, web, Discord bot, contracts, API client, agent runtime, and prompt packages.

items.title: Package layout
items.summary: The main surfaces are packages/backend, packages/discord-bot, packages/web, packages/contracts, packages/api-client, packages/agent-runtime, and packages/prompts.

items.title: Current TrustGraph notes
items.summary: TrustGraph is an optional context integration that can add advisory evidence to chat responses while the backend keeps execution, routing, verification, and terminal authority.

items.title: Recent commit summaries
items.summary: Recent commits include rendering web demo markdown, planning the TrustGraph repo snapshot seed, merging prepared landing scenarios, validating landing response fixtures, and hardening landing scenario generation.
